---
title: "Evidence Audit"
---

The evidence audit surface is still provisional. Canonical evidence records live
in the project data files and must validate before they are used in claims,
publication tables, or exported evidence chains.

## Pilot Calibration Packet

Issue #5 introduces the first real-source calibration candidate. It uses Jacob
Segall's 1922 statistical study of German Jewish soldiers as a
Germany/Judenzaehlung counterevidence source.

This packet is intentionally cautious:

- the source, document, segment, and proposition records are project-owner
  reviewed for pilot calibration;
- the annotation is `observation_reviewed`;
- the negative-evidence and rival-explanation records are reviewed for pilot
  calibration;
- the packet is not an expert-adjudicated scholarly gold standard;
- no interpretation layer or strong Sacrificial Debt evidence claim is attached.

The candidate proposition is used to test whether documented German Jewish war
participation should qualify, weaken, or rival allegations of shirking. It is
not coded as strong Sacrificial Debt evidence, and it is not perpetrator
rhetoric.

Canonical files:

- [`annotations/reference.jsonl`](https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-wrokbench/blob/master/projects/sacrificial-debt/data/annotations/reference.jsonl)
- [`negative-evidence.jsonl`](https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-wrokbench/blob/master/projects/sacrificial-debt/data/negative-evidence.jsonl)
- [`rival-explanations.jsonl`](https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-wrokbench/blob/master/projects/sacrificial-debt/data/rival-explanations.jsonl)
